findings.statement: On the current main the packet's fixtures no longer construct a ScoreRecord (W2-10 made repo: RepoIdentity required), failing twelve store tests -- mechanical rebase work, not a design defect, and the schema is untouched by the fix.
findings.failure_scenario: git cherry-pick 8b9d314 onto 4eeef21 applies with no textual conflict, then the full suite reports '12 failed, 1663 passed' with 'TypeError: ScoreRecord.__init__() missing 1 required positional argument: repo' at tests/store/helpers.py:100, plus 'ValueError: owner/name (acme, r1) does not match record.repo identity (acme, demo)' from W2-10's new TieBreakInput validation.

findings.statement: The writer cannot serialise the real persona_composites contract: canonical_json is handed PersonaComposite dataclasses and raises, so no record the engine will produce can be written.
findings.failure_scenario: On the merged tree, a ScoreRecord whose persona_composites is {'balanced': PersonaComposite(cvi=82.5, coverage=0.9, tier='B', rated=True)} -- main's declared type dict[str, PersonaComposite] since the 2026-09-13 ruling -- makes write_records raise 'TypeError: Object of type PersonaComposite is not JSON serializable'. The packet's suite is green only because tests/store/helpers.py builds the old dict[str, float].

observations: Resolution executed in the trial only: writer serialises with asdict(); the three record builders take owner/name/ecosystem and set repo=RepoIdentity(...); the reader/roundtrip fixtures thread identity and build real PersonaComposite values. 4 files, 45 insertions, 23 deletions -> full suite '1675 passed, 12 warnings in 43.13s'.
No textual conflict hunk exists: pyproject.toml's one-line packages change merged cleanly and no other file overlaps W2-6/W2-7f/W2-9f/W2-10.
The schema needed no change in any of this (git diff --stat over cvi/store/schema.py and cvi/store/migrations/ is empty after the resolution).
